Moji-Guaçu: "Campos das Sete Lagôas". Fazenda Campininha, just north of Rio Moji-Guaçu. 3.7 km. NNW of Padua Sales. (About 27 km. NW of city of Moji-Mirim). Campo cerrado (a type of scrubby woodland originally) on upland, or very rarely forest. Open marsh or dense secondary forest ("mata") along the streams. Area once covered with gallery forest, now cleared and forming a brushy field with shrubs to 2 m tall, plus thick growth of molassas grass. 22º11-18'S., 47º7-10;W.
